name: Persistent Systems

snapshot.about: Digital engineering and enterprise modernization services powered by AI across high-tech, financial services, and healthcare verticals.

narrative: Revenue growth aligned with management guidance, reaching $487.6 million in Q2 FY27 with 20% year-on-year growth. However, net profit declined 25.3% year-on-year to ₹352 crore, and Q2 FY27 EBIT margin of 15% trailed the aspirational 16% to 17% range.

promises.statement: Management aspires to achieve an EBIT margin range of 16% to 17%.

said.quote: Yeah, so from our perspective we have said we want to be in the 16 to 17 % range, that is our aspiration

actual_source.quote: The EBIT margin for the quarter came in at 15%, translating to an EBIT growth of 1.6% quarter-on-quarter and 19.5% year-on-year

promises.note: Q2 FY27 EBIT margin of 15% fell below the aspirational 16% to 17% range.

promises.statement: A new strategic deal will add roughly $125 million plus on an annual basis.

said.quote: So, from this deal perspective, this is a net new deal which will add roughly about $125 million plus on an annual basis and overall for the period of the contract it will be roughly about $650 million plus over 6.5 years

promises.statement: A new strategic contract will generate roughly $650 million plus over 6.5 years.

promises.statement: Persistent aims to have its European business represent 15% or more of total revenue.

said.quote: We add to the European business, we live to our dream of having European business at 15% plus

promises.statement: Management reaffirmed target of achieving $2 billion in revenue by March 2027.

said.quote: I am also happy to share that we remain firmly on track, advancing confidently towards our aspiration of $2 billion by March 2027 and laying the foundation of $5 billion by March 2031

promises.note: Target repeated in later communications to achieve $2 billion revenue by March 2027.

promises.statement: Management expects approximately $50 million of one-time Nagarro transaction expenses across 3 to 4 quarters.

said.quote: Overall, we are expecting one-time expenses to the tune of approximately $50 million spread over three to four quarters

promises.statement: Combined leverage (Net Debt / Combined EBITDA) is expected to reduce to 1x by FY30.

said.quote: The leverage, that is the Net Debt over the combined EBITDA, is going to be 1.9 times-2.5 times based on how much will be the open offer acceptance. So, at 50% plus 1 share to 100%, it is expected to reduce down to 1X by FY2030

promises.statement: Targeting $5 billion annual revenue aspiration by March 2031.

said.quote: I am also happy to share that we remain firmly on track, advancing confidently towards our aspiration of $2 billion by March 2027 and laying the foundation of $5 billion by March 2031

promises.note: Long-term $5 billion revenue target by FY31 reaffirmed in subsequent call.

promises.statement: Management targets reaching an annualized revenue run rate exit of ~$500 million per quarter by Q4 FY27.

said.quote: FY’27, Q4 exit is where we are looking at the run rate being in the range of $500 million or so

promises.note: Quarterly exit run rate target for Q4 FY27 remains pending future quarterly results.

promises.statement: Effective Tax Rate for FY26 is guided to be between 20% and 24%.

said.quote: ETR for FY26 will be in the range of 20%-24%
